name: PetBridge
author: PetBridge

sections.description:
Connect your WordPress website with PetBridge, a platform built for animal shelters and rescues to showcase adoptable pets online. This plugin lets you easily add your PetBridge pet listings to your WordPress website using simple shortcodes.

PetBridge keeps your adoption listings connected between your shelter system and your website. This helps animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations provide up-to-date pet information without manually maintaining listings in WordPress.

Visitors can search and browse adoptable pets, view detailed animal profiles, sign up for adoption alerts, and access adoption details directly from your website while your team manages animals through your existing shelter system or directly within the PetBridge platform.

Why PetBridge

Running a shelter means balancing limited time, limited space, and the constant pressure to help more animals find homes. PetBridge was built to make that easier for your shelter.

Instead of spending hours updating your website, managing listings, or answering the same questions over and over, PetBridge keeps everything in sync automatically. Your adoptable pets are always up to date, your community stays informed, and potential adopters can connect with the right animal at the right time.

More importantly, it helps you move animals through your shelter faster. Real-time listings, instant alerts, and expanded visibility work together to reduce overcrowding, increase adoption rates, and give every pet a better chance at a home.

Because at the end of the day, this is not just about managing a website.
It is about helping more animals get adopted and giving your team the time and tools to focus on what matters most.

External Account Required

This plugin requires an active PetBridge account to retrieve and display adoptable pet listings and related tools.

Create a free account

A free tier is available, with additional features offered through paid plans.

Display Adoptable Pets on Your Website

PetBridge connects your WordPress site with widely used shelter management platforms, including PetPoint, Shelterluv, ShelterBuddy, Chameleon, RescueGroups, and more. This allows shelters to maintain a single source of truth for animal records while automatically displaying adoptable pets on their website.

When animals are added, adopted, or updated in your shelter system, those changes appear on your website in near real time without manual updates.

Organizations that do not use shelter software can also manage pets directly inside the PetBridge platform.

Adoption and Community Engagement Tools

After connecting your PetBridge account, the plugin enables several tools designed specifically for animal welfare organizations.

  • Visitors can browse adoptable pets through a searchable adoption page with filters for species, breed, age, size, and gender.
  • Each animal receives a dedicated detail page displaying photos, descriptions, and adoption information.
  • The Surrender Status widget communicates real time intake availability and helps shelters reduce call volume during high intake periods.
  • The Pet Syndication feature pushes your adoptable pet listings to over 100 national adoption websites.
  • Pet Alerts allow visitors to register their preferences and receive notifications when animals matching their criteria become available.

All of these features appear directly inside your WordPress site so visitors experience a seamless, branded adoption journey.

Designed for Animal Shelters and Rescues

PetBridge is designed specifically for animal welfare organizations. The plugin helps shelters automate pet listings, improve adoption visibility, and reduce staff workload.

Real-time data synchronization keeps listings accurate while allowing staff to focus on animal care rather than website updates.

Because all tools are embedded directly within your WordPress site, visitors can browse pets, sign up for alerts, and view surrender status without leaving your website.

PetBridge Pro & Enterprise

PetBridge Pro expands the plugin with additional customization, enhanced engagement tools, and deeper adoption features designed to help shelters increase visibility and connect more effectively with their community.

Pro & Enterprise features include:

  • Concierge setup and installation on your website
  • Custom styling and layout controls to match your website branding
  • Expanded pet browsing and filtering options
  • Support for multiple shelter locations
  • ReHome community platform
  • Pet Alert capabilities
  • Additional layout options for adoption listings
  • Priority feature updates and improvements
  • Additional features outside the WordPress plugin including Electronic Kennel Cards, Digital Kiosks, Mobile Apps, and more

Learn more about PetBridge plans

Get Started

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Connect your PetBridge account
  3. Add PetBridge shortcodes to any page
  4. Adoptable pets automatically appear on your website

Shelters that do not yet have a PetBridge account can create one here

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or newer
  • HTTPS-enabled website
  • Active PetBridge account
  • JavaScript enabled (including jQuery)

Installation Steps

  1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it through the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to PetBridge in the WordPress Dashboard.
  4. Follow the setup instructions to connect your PetBridge account.
  5. Add PetBridge shortcodes to pages where adoptable pets should appear.

External Services

This plugin connects to the PetBridge platform to retrieve adoptable pet listings, surrender status information, and Pet Alert functionality for display on your WordPress website.

PetBridge is a third-party service operated by PetBridge, Inc.

Service endpoints used by this plugin include:

https://petbridge.com
https://petbridge.org

Data is transmitted to the PetBridge service when:

  • A visitor loads a page containing a PetBridge shortcode
  • A visitor uses search or filtering tools on adoption listings
  • A visitor submits a Pet Alert request
  • An administrator opens the PetBridge settings interface in the WordPress Admin Dashboard

Data sent to the service may include:

  • Your shelter’s PetBridge Client ID
  • Search filters selected by visitors (species, breed, age, sex, size, etc.)
  • Basic browser request information required to load embedded content

The plugin itself does not store visitor personal information in the WordPress database.

PetBridge service policies:

Privacy Policy

Terms of Use

Privacy Policy

The PetBridge WordPress plugin does not collect or store personally identifiable information (PII) within your WordPress site.

Pet listings, adoption data, surrender status information, and Pet Alert forms are loaded directly from the PetBridge platform through embedded content.

Visitor interactions with these features occur through the PetBridge service rather than being stored locally in the WordPress database.

Additional privacy information is available at:

Plugin privacy policy

PetBridge service privacy policy

Website privacy policy
sections.faq:
What should I do after activating the plugin?

Open the PetBridge section in the WordPress Dashboard and follow the setup instructions.

Why is my shortcode not working?

Confirm that jQuery is enabled on your WordPress site and that your website uses an HTTPS connection.

Do I need shelter software to use PetBridge?

No. Pets can be managed directly through the PetBridge platform.

Does the plugin store visitor data?

No. Visitor data is not stored inside WordPress. Pet listings, alerts, and forms load through the PetBridge platform.

How do I display adoptable pets on my website?

After connecting your PetBridge account, you can place PetBridge shortcodes on any page or post to display adoptable pets, Pet Alerts, or surrender status information.

Will my pet listings update automatically?

Yes. PetBridge synchronizes with your shelter management system and updates pet listings automatically. When animals are added, adopted, or updated in your shelter software or the PetBridge platform, those changes appear on your website in near real time.

Can I customize the appearance of the adoption pages?

The plugin uses the PetBridge plan you are signed up for to determine the appearance. Free and Standard plans use default styling, while PetBridge Pro & Enterprise provide additional customization options.

Is the plugin mobile friendly?

Yes. All PetBridge embeds are responsive and designed to work across mobile devices, tablets, and desktop browsers.
